x-formulaRef: Characteristic impedance of the shielded-strip transmission line, S. B. Cohn, IRE Trans. MTT-2 (1954): the exact stripline the solver is held to

solveMode.x-tooltip: Solve: one cross-section, with loss at each frequency and, on request, the width for a target and the tolerance spread. Yield (Pro and API): draws whole boards within the tolerances and reports the fraction that meet the specification.

structureFamily.x-tooltip: The template the cross-section was built from, for labelling only; blank lets the solver name it.

planes.x-tooltip: Bottom: one plane under the stack (microstrip). Both: planes below and above it (stripline). None: no plane, for coplanar waveguide with its own grounds.

layers.x-tooltip: Required for any board: the stack from the bottom up, { thickness (m), er, tanD, dispersion: djordjevic-sarkar | none, refFreq (Hz) }. εr and tanδ are the values at refFreq (default 1 GHz). Empty puts the traces in air.

conductors.x-tooltip: Required: one or two signal traces and any coplanar grounds, { role: signal | ground, boundary (layer boundary it sits on, 0 = bottom), x (left edge, m), width (bottom, m), thickness (m), topWidth or etchFactor, plating (m) }.

mask.x-tooltip: Conformal solder mask on the outer layer: { er, tanD, dispersion, refFreq, overTrace, overSubstrate, betweenTraces (m) }. Blank: no mask.

copper.x-tooltip: Copper conductivity (S/m, default 5.8e7) and roughness: { model: hammerstad-jensen, rms (m) } or { model: huray, noduleRadius (m), surfaceRatio }.

frequencies.x-tooltip: Frequencies in Hz at which impedance and loss are reported. Blank: 1 GHz.

designFrequency.x-tooltip: Where solve-for-width, the tolerance spread and the accuracy rule act; one of the listed frequencies. Blank: the first listed frequency.

solveFor.x-tooltip: { parameter: width | spacing, target (Ω) }: return the cross-section whose impedance (a pair's differential impedance) meets the target. Blank: solve the geometry as given.

tolerances.x-tooltip: Plus-or-minus tolerances: { width (m), etchFactor, thickness (m), layerThickness, er, maskThickness }, the last three as fractions (0.1 for ±10 %). A solve reports the first-order spread they cause; a yield draws every sample within them, and needs at least one. Blank: no spread.

distribution.x-tooltip: How a yield draws each toleranced parameter: uniformly within its ± bound, or from a normal distribution with the bound at three standard deviations, truncated there.

samples.x-tooltip: Boards a yield draws, each solved at the design frequency. 10,000 gives a 95 % interval of about ±1 point at 50 % yield.

specification.x-tooltip: Required for a yield: { target (Ω), tolerance (0.1 for ±10 %) }, tested on Z0 for a single line and on Zdiff for a pair, and on a pair optionally { commonTarget, commonTolerance } too. A sample passes when every stated target holds.

randomSeed.x-tooltip: Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design.
